mentions.name: Pointless
mentions.description: A frictionless Planning Poker webapp for Scrum estimation that requires no sign up and gamifies the ceremony with a JackBox-style fun experience. It is free, includes easter eggs and jokes at the expense of Jira and modern software development, and is built on Cloudflare Durable Objects with PartyKit to make multiplayer easy.
mentions.problem: Scrum ceremonies like Planning Poker should be lightweight but are often painful and tedious.
mentions.audience: Teams following Scrum that want more joy in their estimation ceremonies
mentions.source_excerpt: Over the last few weeks I’ve been building Pointless (https://pointless.cards), a Planning Poker webapp that’s both frictionless (no sign up) and actually fun!
